mentions.author: @priya_growth_ops
mentions.text: We're a 12 person B2B SaaS team and our attribution is a mess of spreadsheets. Looking for a marketing analytics tool we can set up this week. Budget approved. Recommendations?

mentions.author: u/dataquill_dev
mentions.text: Tried the AuraPulse trial. The HubSpot import ran for two hours and then failed with no error message. Support hasn't replied in a day. Kind of losing patience.

mentions.author: SaaS Weekly (fictional)
mentions.text: SignalNest drops its Starter plan from $99 to $49 a month and adds a free tier capped at 1,000 tracked contacts, calling it "analytics for teams that can't afford a data hire".

mentions.author: Marco Ruiz, Head of Marketing at Tiltfield (fictional)
mentions.text: Next quarter we want proper lead scoring tied to campaign spend. Evaluating a few vendors in December. If you've used something that works for a 40 person company, tell me.

mentions.author: @funnelfox
mentions.text: New in FunnelFox: AI campaign summaries in Slack every Monday. "Your whole funnel, one message." Rolling out to all Pro accounts today.
